subject: Re: Request for supplemental credits and extension for Private VPC pilot
messages:

Cc: Novus Health Security Team <security@novushealth.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC pilot — request for supplemental credits and extension

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to move our Private VPC pilot (PHI ingestion + clinical routing) into a 6-week evaluation, but two things have come up on our side:

- Our security team needs to run a quick SOC 2 evidence review (expected ~2 weeks).
- We need additional credits so the pilot covers both inference and embed-heavy validation; our estimate doubled after adding the clinical pipelines.

Can Redwood provide a 6-week extension to the trial window and a supplemental grant (~$6k worth of credits) contingent on us providing the SOC 2 evidence? If you need any evidence right away, we can push preliminary reports from our vendor.

Attaching our SOC checklist for visibility (SOC2-questions-novus-security.xlsx).

Thanks,
Amelia Ross
Senior PM, AI Platforms
Novus Health
(415) 555-0198

Hi Amelia — appreciated the clear ask and the checklist. Short answer: we can likely support a time-limited extension and a supplemental credit grant, but we need a couple of boxes checked on our side first. Specifically:

1) Receipt of SOC evidence (preliminary scans are fine) and confirmation of the audit window;
2) Signed DPA / data handling addendum that covers Private VPC behavior and KMS usage;
3) A plan for times when we need short-term troubleshooting access (jumpbox + SOP).

Ben (CC) — can you pull the approval matrix and advise recommended credit quantum here? If possible, please propose conditional language (e.g., credits released on receipt of SOC evidence + signed DPA).

Amelia — if that works, send over the earliest SOC artifacts and your preferred DPA contact and we'll queue legal. Happy to keep the pilot moving forward.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks Mina —

We can provide the SOC scans and a short attestation by EOD tomorrow. Our procurement/legal lead for DPAs is Brian Keller (brian.keller@novushealth.com).

A couple of practical asks from security:
- Proof of key management options (we want KMS integration; HSM discussion can wait).
- A short runbook for remote debug windows (we prefer scheduled sessions with JIT access).

On credits: we need enough to cover ~250k tokens of generator traffic + 25k embedding calls over the 6-week extension. Not sure how that maps to Redwood units — would appreciate guidance.

— Amelia

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC pilot — request for supplemental credits and extension

Team — reviewed Amelia's ask and the attached SOC preview. Proposed path:

- Approve a conditional supplemental grant of $5,500 in hosted-equivalent credits (applies to Private usage as offset) for a 6-week extension.
- Conditions: SOC evidence upload + signed DPA + scheduled debug SOP. Release to occur in two tranches: $2,750 on SOC evidence receipt, $2,750 on signed DPA.
- Require an ops-rollback clause: if high-risk findings appear in SOC evidence within 14 days, Redwood reserves right to pause the pilot and re-evaluate.

Reasons: keeps spend bounded, aligns legal signoff to second tranche, and gives security a near-term lever. Attached approval matrix and the suggested grant memo for finance.

Attaching: credits-approval-matrix.pdf

If we go ahead, I'll ask Finance to create a non-recurring credit entry against RDW-2026-0173 and route a short MOU for signature. Karthik — can you confirm language for the DPA clause and ops-rollback?

Cheers,
Ben

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC pilot — request for supplemental credits and extension

Ben — looks good. Draft guidance for the clauses below; I'll have Legal produce a short MOU using the DPA template attached (DPA-template-Redwood.docx):

- Credit tranche language: "Redwood will apply a one-time supplemental credit grant (total not exceeding $5,500) to Customer's account per Deal RDW-2026-0173. The first tranche ($2,750) is released upon receipt of SOC 2 evidence as described in Appendix A. The second tranche ($2,750) is released upon execution of the DPA or MOU referencing Redwood's data handling requirements."

- Ops-rollback clause: "If Customer-supplied SOC evidence reveals material security issues related to data handling in Customer's environment, Redwood may suspend access to Private VPC endpoints pending remediation and a follow-up security review."

Action items: Mina — please confirm you'd like us to route the MOU via DocuSign. Finance: issue the credit code only after first tranche approval. Monica — please validate the accounting classification for the grant.

Thanks,
Karthik (Legal, Redwood)
